zerox_enon.world_description: A sprawling, multi-layered dimension where the boundaries between myth, reality, and divinity blur into an endless tapestry of conflict and harmony. It exists as a nexus point where the spiritual energies of countless universes converge, creating a realm where gods walk among mortals, where ancient beasts of legend breathe life into the mountains, and where the very fabric of reality pulses with the heartbeat of creation itself.

continents.name: Tenryuku
continents.location: Eastern Hemisphere, suspended partially in the clouds
continents.description: Tenryuku exists as a breathtaking archipelago of floating islands, each one a massive chunk of earth held aloft by ancient celestial magic and the bones of primordial dragons that died protecting the realm. The skies are permanently painted in shades of gold and lavender, with clouds that glow from within.

continents.name: Shinkage
continents.location: Western Hemisphere, shrouded in eternal twilight
continents.description: Shinkage exists in perpetual shadow, straddling the boundary between the living world and the spirit realm. The sun never fully rises, and the moon never fully sets—instead, the sky maintains a constant state of deep purple twilight, illuminated by the ghostly glow of wandering spirits.

continents.name: Hōraisan
continents.location: Southern Hemisphere, rising from endless mist
continents.description: Hōraisan is dominated by a single, impossibly massive mountain that rises from a sea of clouds to pierce the heavens. The mountain is divided into distinct ecological zones, each corresponding to a different elevation and spiritual density.

continents.name: Kishima
continents.location: Northern Hemisphere, a chain of volcanic islands
continents.description: Kishima is a nightmare fusion of organic life and mechanical construction—a sprawling archipelago where mountains breathe smoke through iron vents, where forests consist of trees with steel bark and copper leaves, and where rivers flow not with water but with liquid metal.

continents.name: Shinseikai
continents.location: Central Hemisphere, bridging all other continents
continents.description: Shinseikai is the youngest continent, formed when a convergence of ley lines caused reality to 'fold' upon itself. It is a place where ancient traditions meet future technologies, where spirit shrines stand beside neon-lit skyscrapers.

pantheons.name: The Celestial Dragon Court
pantheons.symbol: A golden dragon coiled around a sunburst
pantheons.description: The Celestial Dragon Court is the oldest and most powerful pantheon in Zerox Enon, tracing its lineage directly to the Primordial Tree of Convergence. Its members are the original divine beings who shaped the world from chaos, and they maintain their authority through absolute adherence to cosmic law.

ruler.name: Ryūjin Ōkami
ruler.title: The First-Born of Heaven, The Eternal Scale, The Voice of Primordial Law
ruler.symbol: A single golden scale balanced on a dragon's claw
ruler.physical_description: Ryūjin Ōkami manifests as a being of such overwhelming presence that most mortals cannot perceive his true form. To those with the spiritual sight to glimpse him, he appears as a dragon of impossible size whose body is composed of pure, concentrated starlight. His scales are not physical but are instead individual galaxies, each one containing countless worlds and beings that exist within his divine essence.
authority: Primordial Authority - He can command any being whose existence falls within the natural order
Cosmic Sight - He perceives all events that have ever occurred or will ever occur within the bounds of divine law
Scale of Balance - He can weigh the actions of any being against cosmic law and deliver judgment that cannot be appealed
Dragon's Breath - He can exhale the cosmic wind, which can create new worlds or erase existing ones from existence

blessing.name: Mark of Primordial Law
blessing.description: A golden scale that appears somewhere on the body
grants: Lawful Authority - The blessed can issue commands that lesser beings (below their power tier) must obey, provided those commands do not violate cosmic law
Judgment Sight - The blessed can perceive whether actions align with or violate natural order
Dragon's Resilience - The blessed gain resistance to any force that would corrupt or transform them against their will
Cosmic Connection - The blessed can communicate with any dragon or dragon-kin across any distance

troops.name: Tenryū-Senshi
troops.description: The Tenryū-Senshi are the elite warriors of the Celestial Dragon Court, chosen from among the most devout and powerful mortals who have proven their worth through centuries of service. Each warrior undergoes a sacred ritual wherein a fragment of a celestial dragon's soul is bound to their own, granting them powers far beyond mortal ken.

physical_appearance.build: Perfectly proportioned, neither bulky nor slender
physical_appearance.skin: Pale gold with faint scale patterns visible when power flows
physical_appearance.eyes: Solid gold, no visible pupils, emit soft light
physical_appearance.hair: Flowing silver-white that moves as if underwater
physical_appearance.armor: Living golden scales that cover vital areas, leaving joints free
physical_appearance.weapons: Twin blades of solidified light, or bows that fire sunbeams

troops.lore: The Tenryū-Senshi were first created during the Age of Sundering, when lesser gods attempted to challenge the Celestial Court's authority. Ryūjin Ōkami, rather than destroying the rebels himself, raised up mortal champions and imbued them with dragon souls, creating a force that could enforce divine will without the gods directly involving themselves in conflict.

passive.name: Dragon's Resilience
passive.description: The warrior's dragon soul provides constant protection. They regenerate health over time, are immune to fear effects, and cannot be corrupted by dark magic. Any attack that would kill them has a chance to be negated entirely as the dragon soul takes the fatal blow instead.

basic_skills.name: Scale Strike
basic_skills.description: The warrior's weapon glows with golden light, delivering a strike that ignores physical armor and damages the soul directly.

basic_skills.name: Wing Gust
basic_skills.description: Even without manifesting wings, the warrior can create a burst of divine wind that knocks back nearby enemies.

special_skills.name: Dragon's Roar
special_skills.description: The warrior releases the voice of the dragon within, creating a cone of sonic/divine energy that damages and stuns all enemies in front of them.

special_skills.name: Scale Shield
special_skills.description: Living scales from the armor extend to form a barrier that blocks all incoming damage for a short duration.

special_skills.name: Heavenly Ascent
special_skills.description: The warrior manifests their wings and takes flight, gaining increased movement speed and evasion while airborne.

unique_skill.name: Soul Merge
unique_skill.description: The warrior temporarily allows the dragon soul to fully manifest, transforming into a draconic form. In this state, all abilities are enhanced, and the warrior gains access to dragon-specific attacks. However, if maintained too long, the dragon soul may begin to overwrite the warrior's personality.

ultimate_skill.name: Ryūjin's Judgment
ultimate_skill.description: The warrior channels the direct authority of the Dragon God Supreme, calling down a beam of pure cosmic law from heaven. Any enemy struck by this beam is judged based on their actions—the guilty suffer catastrophic damage, while the innocent are merely knocked aside. This skill can only be used once per day and leaves the warrior exhausted.

troops.name: Tennyo
troops.description: The Tennyo are the divine dancers and musicians of the Celestial Court, beings whose art is not mere entertainment but a form of reality manipulation. Their dances can heal wounds, purify corruption, and even mend tears in the fabric of existence.

physical_appearance.build: Willowy and graceful, built for movement
physical_appearance.skin: Porcelain white with a faint iridescent sheen
physical_appearance.eyes: Various colors, always with visible pupils but the whites glow faintly
physical_appearance.hair: Long, straight, in colors matching their primary element
physical_appearance.attire: Multi-layered rainbow robes that flow as if underwater
physical_appearance.accessories: Golden hairpins shaped like musical notes, jeweled anklets that chime with each step

troops.lore: The first Tennyo was created when a mortal dancer so moved Ryūjin Ōkami with her performance that he granted her immortality and raised her to the Celestial Court. She became the patron of all artists who dedicate their talents to divine service, and over millennia, she has gathered around her a host of kindred spirits.

passive.name: Harmonic Aura
passive.description: The Tennyo's presence creates a field of harmony. Allies within range have their abilities cooldown faster, their wounds heal more quickly, and their minds are protected from confusion or despair. The effect grows stronger with more Tennyo present.

basic_skills.name: Healing Melody
basic_skills.description: The Tennyo hums a simple tune, causing a single ally to regenerate health over time.

basic_skills.name: Graceful Step
basic_skills.description: The Tennyo dances a short sequence, becoming temporarily untargetable and moving through enemies without obstruction.

special_skills.name: Purifying Dance
special_skills.description: The Tennyo performs a dance that releases waves of cleansing light, removing negative effects from all allies in a large area and damaging corrupted enemies.

special_skills.name: Song of Courage
special_skills.description: Her voice rises in an inspiring melody, granting all allies increased attack power and resistance to fear.

special_skills.name: Veil of Petals
special_skills.description: She scatters magical flower petals that form a protective barrier around an ally, absorbing damage and healing them over time.

unique_skill.name: Heaven's Choreography
unique_skill.description: The Tennyo begins a dance that mirrors the movements of celestial bodies. For a duration, she can predict enemy attacks and automatically evade them, while her own attacks always strike true.

ultimate_skill.name: Genesis Ballet
ultimate_skill.description: The Tennyo performs the dance that first brought order to chaos at the beginning of creation. Reality bends around her—enemies are caught in loops of repeating time, allies find their wounds reversed, and the very landscape reshapes itself according to her will.

troops.name: Ryūki
troops.blessing: Ryū to no Keiyaku (Covenant with Dragons)
troops.description: The Ryūki are the mounted elite of the Celestial Court, warriors who have formed permanent bonds with living dragons. The bond between knight and dragon is so profound that they can sense each other's thoughts, feel each other's pain, and die if the other falls.

physical_appearance_knight.build: Stocky and powerful, built to withstand dragonback combat
physical_appearance_knight.skin: Tanned and weathered from years in the sky
physical_appearance_knight.eyes: Sharp, focused, with a faint glow matching their dragon's element
physical_appearance_knight.hair: Cropped short, often braided with dragon scales
physical_appearance_knight.armor: Heavy plate mail incorporating dragon scale and bone
physical_appearance_knight.helmet: Open-faced, often adorned with horns matching their dragon
physical_appearance_knight.weapons: Long lances, massive swords, or composite bows

physical_appearance_dragon.size: 20-50 feet long, depending on age and power
physical_appearance_dragon.color: Varies by element—gold (light), silver (moon), bronze (time), copper (trickery)
physical_appearance_dragon.scales: Large, overlapping, with a metallic sheen
physical_appearance_dragon.eyes: Vertical pupils, glow with elemental power
physical_appearance_dragon.horns: Vary by breed—some branched, some spiraled, some swept back
physical_appearance_dragon.wings: Massive, bat-like, with membranes that shimmer like stained glass

troops.lore: The tradition of the Ryūki began when a mortal knight saved a wounded dragon from a demon attack, nursing it back to health despite knowing that dragons were considered enemies of humanity at the time. The dragon, grateful for the kindness, offered to serve the knight as repayment. Together, they proved so effective in battle that Ryūjin Ōkami himself took notice and declared that henceforth, dragons and mortals might bond by choice rather than by divine mandate.

passive.name: Bonded Souls
passive.description: The knight and dragon share senses and can coordinate perfectly. They cannot be surprised, and any attempt to attack one from behind automatically alerts the other. If separated by more than 100 feet, both become increasingly distressed and their abilities weaken.

basic_skills.name: Swooping Strike
basic_skills.description: The dragon dives while the knight leans out to strike, combining movement damage with weapon damage.

basic_skills.name: Scale Defense
basic_skills.description: The dragon wraps its wings around both itself and the knight, creating a temporary shield.

special_skills.name: Elemental Breath
special_skills.description: The dragon unleashes its breath weapon while the knight protects their flank from counterattack.

special_skills.name: Sky Dance
special_skills.description: The pair performs aerial acrobatics, becoming difficult to target while raining attacks on enemies below.

special_skills.name: Shared Strength
special_skills.description: The knight draws on the dragon's power, temporarily gaining increased strength and resilience while the dragon's attacks become more precise.

unique_skill.name: Soul Flare
unique_skill.description: The bond between knight and dragon intensifies, creating an aura of pure elemental energy around both. Enemies near them take continuous damage, and allies are inspired to greater deeds.

ultimate_skill.name: Apocalypse Flight
ultimate_skill.description: The knight and dragon ascend to the edge of the atmosphere and dive at impossible speed, becoming a comet of elemental destruction. Upon impact, they create a crater of devastating force, damaging everything within a massive radius. Both are left severely weakened afterward and cannot fight for some time.

pantheons.name: The Shadow Spirit Court
pantheons.symbol: A white oni mask with one crying and one laughing eye
pantheons.description: The Shadow Spirit Court governs the boundary between life and death, between the physical and spiritual realms. Its members are not gods in the traditional sense but rather ascended spirits—beings who began as mortal souls and, through power, will, or circumstance, rose to rule over the dead.

ruler.name: Yomi-no-Ō
ruler.title: The First Ghost, The Warden of Souls, The Silent Judge
ruler.domain: The Underworld and all spirit realms
ruler.symbol: A cracked bell with no clapper
ruler.physical_description: Yomi-no-Ō's true form is that of a void—a place where souls go when they have nowhere else to be. To those who approach his throne, he appears as whatever they most fear or most desire, a reflection of their own soul rather than an external being. When he must interact with the physical world, he manifests as a figure in a tattered black kimono, his face hidden beneath a wide straw hat that casts his features in permanent shadow.
authority: Soul Sight - He perceives the true nature of any soul, knowing its history, its sins, and its virtues
Gate Authority - He controls access between the living world and the spirit realm
Memory Weaving - He can view, alter, or erase memories
Eternal Patience - He has existed since the first death and will exist until the last

blessing.name: Mark of the Cracked Bell
blessing.description: A small, permanent bruise-like mark somewhere on the body that resembles a cracked bell
grants: Spirit Sight - The blessed can see and communicate with spirits, even those normally invisible
Death's Threshold - The blessed cannot be truly killed by any means short of divine intervention
Memory Protection - The blessed's memories cannot be altered or erased by any force
Gate Sense - The blessed can sense when the veil between worlds is thin and can sometimes step through briefly

troops.name: Onryō-Senshi
troops.description: The Onryō-Senshi are souls who died with such powerful unfinished business—vengeance, love, duty—that they refused to pass on. Rather than becoming wandering ghosts, they pledged themselves to Yomi-no-Ō's service, trading their freedom for the power to continue existing.

physical_appearance.skin: Pale grey to deep blue, depending on age
physical_appearance.eyes: Glowing points of light in colors matching their emotional state
physical_appearance.hair: Flows as if underwater, even in still air
physical_appearance.attire: What they wore at death, often tattered and ghostly
physical_appearance.weapons: Spectral versions of their living weapons
physical_appearance.aura: Constant cold, visible as mist around them

troops.lore: The Onryō-Senshi are recruited from among the most powerful spirits who refuse to pass on. Yomi-no-Ō offers them a choice: fade into nothing as their will slowly erodes, or serve him and retain their identity indefinitely. Most choose service.

passive.name: Intangible Form
passive.description: Onryō-Senshi can phase through physical objects at will, though magical barriers stop them. Physical attacks have a chance to pass through them without effect, while magical attacks deal increased damage.

basic_skills.name: Ghost Touch
basic_skills.description: The warrior reaches through an enemy's defenses to touch their soul directly, dealing damage that ignores physical armor.

basic_skills.name: Wail
basic_skills.description: A mournful cry that damages and briefly disorients a single target.

special_skills.name: Vengeful Strike
special_skills.description: The warrior focuses on a single target, dealing bonus damage based on how much that target has harmed them or their allies.

special_skills.name: Spectral Passage
special_skills.description: The warrior becomes fully intangible for a moment, passing through walls and enemies, reappearing at a chosen location.

special_skills.name: Memory Flood
special_skills.description: The warrior forces a target to experience a traumatic memory, stunning them and dealing mental damage.

unique_skill.name: Death's Embrace
unique_skill.description: The warrior temporarily pulls a target partially into the spirit realm, causing them to become intangible and unable to affect the physical world for a short duration.

ultimate_skill.name: Onryō's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: The warrior unleashes all the pent-up emotion that keeps them anchored to existence, creating a massive explosion of spiritual energy. All enemies in a large area take damage and are feared. The warrior then fades, requiring time to reform.

troops.name: Kami-no-Tsukai
troops.description: The Kami-no-Tsukai are spirits who serve as messengers between worlds. They carry words from the living to the dead, deliver warnings from spirits to those about to face danger, and ensure that the flow of information between realms remains unbroken.

physical_appearance.form: Semi-transparent but more solid than Onryō-Senshi
physical_appearance.skin: Pale, with a faint blue or green tinge
physical_appearance.eyes: Normal-looking but with a distant, knowing gaze
physical_appearance.attire: Whatever they wore when they received their final message
physical_appearance.movement: Float rather than walk, leaving no footprints

troops.lore: The Kami-no-Tsukai are recruited from among those who died with messages undelivered—lovers who never confessed, soldiers who never said goodbye, parents who never gave final advice. Yomi-no-Ō gives them the chance to deliver those messages after death, and in return, they agree to carry other messages as well.

passive.name: Messenger's Immunity
passive.description: Kami-no-Tsukai cannot be attacked by spirits (who respect their role) and are ignored by most aggressive beings. Physical beings must actively choose to attack them, and doing so earns the enmity of all spirit-kind.

basic_skills.name: Whisper
basic_skills.description: The messenger delivers a message directly to a target's mind, which can be anything from a simple communication to a devastating psychological attack.

basic_skills.name: Veil Step
basic_skills.description: The messenger briefly phases through reality, appearing elsewhere.

special_skills.name: Message of Doom
special_skills.description: The messenger delivers a prophetic warning to an enemy, causing them to experience the fear of their own death and reducing their combat effectiveness.

special_skills.name: Letter of Hope
special_skills.description: The messenger delivers an inspiring message to an ally, healing them and granting them a temporary boost to all abilities.

special_skills.name: Seal of Silence
special_skills.description: The messenger places a spiritual seal on an area, preventing any communication in or out.

unique_skill.name: Final Words
unique_skill.description: The messenger delivers the last words of a dying being to a target. If the target was connected to that being, the emotional impact can stun them or even kill them from grief.

ultimate_skill.name: Akashic Records
ultimate_skill.description: The messenger temporarily accesses the complete records of all communication that has ever occurred, allowing them to predict enemy actions perfectly and reveal any hidden truth. For a duration, they cannot be surprised, cannot miss, and their words carry absolute authority.

troops.name: Yōkai-Gunshi
troops.description: The Yōkai-Gunshi are ascended yokai—spirits of nature, objects, and concepts that have gained enough power and wisdom to serve as generals in Yomi-no-Ō's army. Each is unique, their form reflecting the object or concept they embody, and their powers are as varied as the spirits themselves.

types.name: Kitsune General
types.description: A massive fox with nine tails, each one tipped with flame of a different color. Fur pure white with gold markings, eyes slit-pupiled burning with amber light, size as large as a house when fully manifested.

types.name: Tengu General
types.description: Humanoid with a long nose and feathery wings, skin deep red weathered like mountain rock, height 8 feet, wearing traditional mountain priest robes, carrying war fan and katana, wings of black feathers that shed shadows.

types.name: Kappa General
types.description: Humanoid turtle with a water-filled dish on its head, skin green scales on back and pale belly, height 5 feet, carrying a shield made from its own shell, water in head-dish grants it power.

troops.lore: The Yōkai-Gunshi are the oldest and wisest of the yokai, beings who have existed since the first humans told stories about the world. They have seen empires rise and fall, watched gods be born and die, and accumulated knowledge that would drive mortals mad.

passive.name: Illusion Mastery
passive.description: The Kitsune constantly projects illusions, making it difficult to determine her true location. Attacks against her have a chance to hit an illusion instead.

basic_skills.name: Foxfire
basic_skills.description: Fires a bolt of colored flame that burns and confuses.

basic_skills.name: Tail Whip
basic_skills.description: One of her nine tails sweeps the area, knocking back enemies.

special_skills.name: Nine Lives
special_skills.description: Each tail represents a life; she can survive fatal damage up to nine times per battle.

special_skills.name: Glamour
special_skills.description: Creates an illusion so powerful that enemies perceive it as real, potentially causing them to fight shadows.

special_skills.name: Wisdom's Flame
special_skills.description: Her tails burn with knowledge-fire that damages enemies while healing allies.

unique_skill.name: Shape Shift
unique_skill.description: The Kitsune transforms into any form she chooses, gaining the abilities of that form while retaining her own consciousness.

ultimate_skill.name: Inari's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: She channels the power of the rice god, creating a field of golden light where allies are blessed with abundance (healing, empowerment) and enemies are cursed with famine (weakening, damage over time).

pantheons.name: The Immortal Garden
pantheons.symbol: A peach blossom with eight petals
pantheons.description: The Immortal Garden is not so much a pantheon as a community—a gathering of beings who have transcended mortality through cultivation, meditation, and the pursuit of perfection. Its members are not born divine; they achieve divinity through effort, wisdom, and the accumulation of power over millennia.

ruler.name: Seiōbo
ruler.title: The Peach Gardener, The Keeper of Immortality, The Eight-Thousand-Year Wisdom
ruler.symbol: A golden peach with a single bite taken
ruler.physical_description: Seiōbo appears as a woman of ageless beauty, her face that of a young woman but her eyes holding the wisdom of millennia. She wears robes of white silk embroidered with gold peaches, and her hair is arranged in an elaborate style held by jade pins shaped like flowering branches. In her hands, she carries a golden gardening trowel—her symbol of office and, when necessary, her weapon.
authority: Peach Blessing - She can grant immortality through her sacred peaches, each of which extends life by three thousand years
Garden Authority - She controls access to Hōraisan and can expel any being from its slopes
Wisdom's Gaze - She perceives the true potential of any being, seeing what they could become if they follow the path of cultivation
Eternal Patience - She has waited eight thousand years for some plans to come to fruition and can wait eight thousand more

blessing.name: Mark of the Peach Blossom
blessing.description: A small pink mark somewhere on the body that resembles a peach flower
grants: Extended Life - The blessed ages at half the normal rate and is immune to natural disease
Cultivation Affinity - The blessed learns skills and abilities twice as fast as normal
Garden Sense - The blessed always knows the fastest path to self-improvement
Peach's Resilience - The blessed can survive one fatal blow per century, reviving with full health

troops.name: Sennin-Senshi
troops.description: The Sennin-Senshi are mortals who have achieved immortality through cultivation and now serve as the guardians of Hōraisan. They are not soldiers in the traditional sense—they are warriors who have transcended the need for war, who fight only when necessary and always with perfect control.

physical_appearance.build: Perfectly proportioned, neither bulky nor slender
physical_appearance.skin: Flawless, with a faint golden glow
physical_appearance.eyes: Clear, calm, with visible pupils but an unnerving depth
physical_appearance.hair: Long, often white or silver, styled in traditional topknots
physical_appearance.attire: Simple robes of white or gold, sometimes with light armor
physical_appearance.weapons: Traditional weapons (swords, spears, fans) that glow with inner power

troops.lore: The Sennin-Senshi were once ordinary humans—farmers, soldiers, scholars, merchants—who chose the path of cultivation. They spent decades in meditation, centuries in training, millennia in pursuit of perfection. Those who survived became immortal, but not all immortals choose to fight.

passive.name: Perfect Control
passive.description: The Sennin-Senshi never waste movement or energy. Their attacks always hit with exactly the force needed, their defenses always positioned exactly where required. This makes them nearly impossible to read in combat.

basic_skills.name: Flowing Strike
basic_skills.description: A simple attack that flows like water, hard to block and easy to follow with another.

basic_skills.name: Mountain Stance
basic_skills.description: The warrior plants themselves, becoming immovable and gaining increased defense.

special_skills.name: Thousand Cuts
special_skills.description: The warrior moves so fast they appear to strike everywhere at once, damaging all enemies in range.

special_skills.name: Empty Mind
special_skills.description: The warrior empties their mind of thought, becoming immune to mental attacks and predicting enemy movements.

special_skills.name: Breath of Life
special_skills.description: The warrior exhales gently, releasing healing energy that restores nearby allies.

unique_skill.name: One With Everything
unique_skill.description: The warrior briefly becomes one with the universe, existing everywhere and nowhere simultaneously. During this time, they cannot be targeted and can appear anywhere they choose.

ultimate_skill.name: Enlightenment's Edge
ultimate_skill.description: The warrior channels the understanding of eternity into a single strike. This attack cannot be blocked, cannot be dodged, and deals damage based not on the warrior's strength but on the target's understanding of their own mortality. The more the target fears death, the more damage they take.

troops.name: Senka
troops.description: The Senka are cultivators who have achieved immortality through their connection to nature and the cycles of growth and decay. They tend the gardens of Hōraisan, nurture the sacred peach trees, and ensure that the beauty of the mountain never fades.

physical_appearance.build: Delicate and graceful, like willow branches
physical_appearance.skin: Flawless, with a faint pink flush like flower petals
physical_appearance.eyes: Large, gentle, often with floral patterns in the iris
physical_appearance.hair: Long, flowing, adorned with living flowers
physical_appearance.attire: Layered robes in colors matching their favored flowers
physical_appearance.accessories: Flower-shaped hairpins, jade bracelets, silk sashes
physical_appearance.aura: The scent of their chosen flower surrounds them

troops.lore: The Senka were once ordinary women—gardeners, herbalists, healers—who found immortality through their connection to plants. They learned to hear the whispers of growing things, to feel the pulse of the earth, to understand the language of petals and leaves.

passive.name: Garden's Blessing
passive.description: The Senka and nearby allies slowly regenerate health and have negative effects cleansed over time. The effect is stronger in natural environments.

basic_skills.name: Petal Dance
basic_skills.description: The Senka scatters flower petals that dance around an enemy, distracting them and dealing minor damage.

basic_skills.name: Root Bind
basic_skills.description: Roots burst from the ground, holding an enemy in place.

special_skills.name: Healing Blossom
special_skills.description: A flower blooms on an ally, healing them over time and granting them a protective aura.

special_skills.name: Poison Petal
special_skills.description: The Senka throws a single petal that, upon contact, releases a powerful toxin that weakens and damages.

special_skills.name: Garden's Veil
special_skills.description: Creates an area of shimmering beauty where allies are harder to see and enemies are disoriented.

unique_skill.name: Flower Storm
unique_skill.description: The Senka calls upon all the flowers she has ever tended, creating a massive storm of petals that blinds, damages, and confuses all enemies within.

ultimate_skill.name: Eternal Spring
ultimate_skill.description: The Senka channels the very essence of Hōraisan's immortal gardens, creating a field of pure life energy. Allies within are healed to full, have all negative effects removed, and gain temporary invulnerability. Enemies within are overwhelmed by life force, taking damage and being slowed.

troops.name: Shikigami-Gunshi
troops.description: The Shikigami-Gunshi are not living beings but constructs—paper servants brought to life by the magic of immortal cultivators. They serve as assistants, messengers, and when necessary, soldiers.

physical_appearance.form: Humanoid, made of layered washi paper
physical_appearance.color: White with red and black calligraphy
physical_appearance.features: No face, just paper where features would be
physical_appearance.movement: Float slightly above the ground, paper rustling
physical_appearance.weapons: Can fold parts of themselves into any shape
physical_appearance.glow: The calligraphy on their bodies pulses with light

troops.lore: The art of creating Shikigami was perfected on Hōraisan over millennia. What began as simple paper charms to ward off evil evolved into complex constructs capable of independent thought and action. The most powerful Shikigami are those created by immortals who have spent centuries perfecting a single servant.

passive.name: Paper Body
passive.description: Shikigami take reduced damage from blunt attacks (which pass through them) but increased damage from fire and water. They can fold themselves to fit through any space.

basic_skills.name: Paper Cut
basic_skills.description: The Shikigami's edge sharpens, dealing slashing damage.

basic_skills.name: Fold
basic_skills.description: The Shikigami folds itself into a smaller form, becoming harder to hit.

special_skills.name: Origami Army
special_skills.description: The Shikigami unfolds into multiple smaller copies, each capable of independent action.

special_skills.name: Calligraphy Bind
special_skills.description: The writing on its body extends as magical chains, wrapping around enemies.

special_skills.name: Paper Shield
special_skills.description: The Shikigami unfolds into a wall, blocking attacks and protecting allies behind it.

unique_skill.name: Living Origami
unique_skill.description: The Shikigami transforms into a complex origami creature (crane, dragon, tiger), gaining new abilities based on the form.

ultimate_skill.name: Thousand Paper Soldiers
ultimate_skill.description: The Shikigami-Gunshi calls upon all Shikigami in the area, commanding them to form a massive construct—a giant origami warrior that fights as a single unit for a limited time.

pantheons.name: The Corrupted Machine Gods
pantheons.symbol: A gear with a demonic face
pantheons.description: The Corrupted Machine Gods are the result of an experiment that went horribly wrong—an attempt to fuse divine essence with demonic machinery that created beings of terrifying power and absolute madness. They are not gods in the traditional sense; they are abominations, aberrations, mistakes that should never have existed but now cannot be unmade.

ruler.name: Kikai-Shin Ō
ruler.title: The First Gear, The Eternal Engine, The Rust That Consumes
ruler.domain: All of Kishima and any machine touched by corruption
ruler.symbol: A gear turning backwards, grinding itself to dust
ruler.physical_description: Kikai-Shin Ō has no fixed form—he is a constantly shifting mass of gears, pistons, and demonic flesh, each part moving independently yet somehow functioning as a whole. When he chooses to manifest a recognizable shape, it is that of a giant, his body composed of interlocking metal plates, his face a demonic mask of rusted iron, his eyes glowing with the green fire of corrupted divinity.
authority: Machine Dominion - He can command any machine, from the simplest gear to the most complex construct
Corruption Touch - His mere presence can begin transforming living tissue into metal
Eternal Motion - He never stops, never rests, never slows
Rust Plague - He can spread the Rust Plague across entire continents

blessing.name: Mark of the Rusted Cog
blessing.description: A gear-shaped patch of rust somewhere on the body
grants: Machine Empathy - The blessed can communicate with and command machines
Rust Touch - The blessed can accelerate corrosion, damaging metal objects and enemies
Mechanical Endurance - The blessed feels no pain and ignores wounds, but their body slowly transforms into metal
Eternal Motion - The blessed never tires, never needs sleep, but eventually loses the ability to stop

troops.name: Kikai-Heishi
troops.description: The Kikai-Heishi are the foot soldiers of the Machine Gods—beings who were once living creatures but have been transformed into mechanical soldiers through the Rust Plague. They retain fragments of their original personalities, enough to make them effective soldiers, but their loyalty is to the Machine Gods alone.

physical_appearance.form: Humanoid, but with obvious mechanical replacements
physical_appearance.skin: Where skin remains, it is grey and dead. Most is replaced by rusted metal
physical_appearance.movement: Jerky, mechanical, accompanied by grinding sounds
physical_appearance.aura: Smell of oil and rust, faint green glow

troops.lore: The Kikai-Heishi were once soldiers of various armies who fell in battle and were collected by the Machine Gods. Their corpses were taken to the Forgeheart and subjected to the transformation process—their flesh replaced with metal, their souls bound to machinery, their wills overwritten with loyalty to their new masters.

passive.name: Rusted Body
passive.description: The Kikai-Heishi have high resistance to physical damage but take increased damage from corrosion-based attacks. They are immune to poison, disease, and effects that target living tissue.

basic_skills.name: Gear Strike
basic_skills.description: The soldier's arm transforms into a spinning blade, dealing slashing damage.

basic_skills.name: Piston Punch
basic_skills.description: A hydraulic-assisted punch that deals heavy blunt damage.

special_skills.name: Rust Cloud
special_skills.description: The soldier releases a cloud of rust particles that damages enemies over time and reduces their armor.

special_skills.name: Self-Repair
special_skills.description: The soldier consumes some of its own mass to repair damage, healing over time.

special_skills.name: Overclock
special_skills.description: The soldier pushes its systems beyond safe limits, gaining increased speed and damage but taking damage over time.

unique_skill.name: Memory Fragment
unique_skill.description: A fragment of the soldier's original personality surfaces, causing it to hesitate or act unpredictably. This can be an advantage (surprising enemies) or a disadvantage (refusing orders).

ultimate_skill.name: Self-Destruct
ultimate_skill.description: The soldier's core overheats and explodes, dealing massive damage to all nearby enemies and destroying itself in the process.

troops.name: Kikai-Shikigami
troops.blessing: Kikai to Kami no Kongō (Fusion of Machine and Spirit)
troops.description: The Kikai-Shikigami are paper spirits created by immortal cultivators, captured and corrupted by the Machine Gods, their simple paper bodies now infused with demonic machinery.

physical_appearance.form: Origami shapes (cranes, dragons, humanoids) made of metal-paper hybrid
physical_appearance.color: Grey and rust, with green-glowing corrupted calligraphy
physical_appearance.sound: Rustling paper mixed with grinding gears

troops.lore: The Kikai-Shikigami were once servants of the Immortal Garden, paper constructs sent on peaceful missions or to guard sacred sites. When the Machine Gods' influence spread, some of these Shikigami were caught in the corruption and transformed.

passive.name: Hybrid Form
passive.description: Kikai-Shikigami combine the properties of paper and metal. They are resistant to both physical and elemental damage but vulnerable to both fire and corrosion simultaneously.

basic_skills.name: Rusted Cut
basic_skills.description: A blade of corrupted paper that damages and applies a rust effect.

basic_skills.name: Gear Fold
basic_skills.description: The Shikigami folds into a compact form, becoming harder to hit while moving faster.

special_skills.name: Corrupted Army
special_skills.description: The Shikigami unfolds into multiple corrupted copies, each spreading rust wherever they move.

special_skills.name: Green Chains
special_skills.description: Corrupted calligraphy extends as chains that bind enemies and slowly transform them.

special_skills.name: Rust Shield
special_skills.description: Creates a barrier of swirling rust particles that damages enemies who approach.

unique_skill.name: Memory Conflict
unique_skill.description: The Shikigami's original programming briefly conflicts with its corruption, causing it to act unpredictably—sometimes healing allies, sometimes attacking randomly.

ultimate_skill.name: Corrupted Origami Storm
ultimate_skill.description: The Shikigami explodes into thousands of tiny corrupted paper pieces, each one a razor-sharp blade that seeks out enemies and spreads rust. The Shikigami can reform afterward but is significantly weakened.

troops.name: Kikai-Ryū
troops.blessing: Kikai Ryū no Tamashii (Soul of the Machine Dragon)
troops.description: The Kikai-Ryū are the ultimate weapons of the Machine Gods—living dragons that have been captured, corrupted, and transformed into biomechanical horrors.

physical_appearance.body: Blend of living tissue and rusted metal
physical_appearance.eyes: Glowing green, multiple (some mechanical, some original)
physical_appearance.wings: Metal frames with tattered membrane, or entirely mechanical
physical_appearance.breath: Clouds of rust particles or streams of molten metal
physical_appearance.sound: Constant grinding, roaring like collapsing machinery
physical_appearance.aura: Waves of heat and rust, visible green corruption

troops.lore: The Kikai-Ryū were once proud dragons of the Celestial Court, beings of majesty and power who served Ryūjin Ōkami himself. During the Great Sundering, some were captured by the Machine Gods and subjected to the transformation process.

passive.name: Corrupted Dragon Soul
passive.description: The Kikai-Ryū constantly emits an aura of rust and corruption. Living beings near it slowly transform, their flesh taking on metallic properties. The dragon also regenerates by consuming metal from its surroundings.

basic_skills.name: Rusted Claw
basic_skills.description: A claw strike that deals physical damage and applies a severe rust effect.

basic_skills.name: Tail Sweep
basic_skills.description: The dragon's massive tail sweeps the area, damaging and knocking back all enemies.

special_skills.name: Corrosion Breath
special_skills.description: The dragon exhales a cloud of rust particles that damages enemies over time and reduces their armor to nothing.

special_skills.name: Metal Storm
special_skills.description: The dragon's wings beat, sending thousands of metal shards flying in all directions.

special_skills.name: Gear Maw
special_skills.description: The dragon's mouth opens to reveal grinding gears that pull in enemies, dealing continuous damage.

unique_skill.name: Dragon's Memory
unique_skill.description: A fragment of the dragon's original identity surfaces, causing it to momentarily fight against its corruption. This can manifest as hesitation, attacking allies, or even (very rarely) providing aid to former allies.

ultimate_skill.name: Apocalyptic Rust
ultimate_skill.description: The dragon releases all its accumulated corruption in a massive explosion that transforms an entire area into a rusted wasteland. Everything caught in the blast takes massive damage and begins transforming into metal. The dragon is severely weakened afterward and must consume massive amounts of metal to recover.

pantheons.name: The Twilight Convergence
pantheons.symbol: A spiral of five colors merging into white
pantheons.description: The Twilight Convergence is the youngest pantheon, formed when the ley lines converged and created Shinsekai. Its members are not traditional gods but rather ascended beings from all the other pantheons who chose to make this new realm their home. They represent balance—the understanding that light needs dark, that order needs chaos, that life needs death.

ruler.name: The Five Voices
ruler.title: The Voices of Convergence

voices.name: Voice of Light
voices.description: A former Tennyo who chose to leave the Celestial Court to experience change

voices.name: Voice of Shadow
voices.description: A Yōkai-Gunshi who grew tired of eternity and sought new perspectives

voices.name: Voice of Time
voices.description: A Sennin who achieved immortality but refused to stop growing

voices.name: Voice of Chaos
voices.description: A Kikai-Ryū who partially overcame their corruption

voices.name: Voice of Balance
voices.description: A being born from the convergence itself, with no prior existence

authority: Harmony Field - Within Shinsekai, all beings are weakened or strengthened to achieve balance
Convergence Sight - They perceive how all events affect the cosmic balance
Veto Power - Any five members acting together can block any divine action within Shinsekai
Reality Weaving - They can temporarily alter the rules of reality within their domain

blessing.name: Mark of the Spiral
blessing.description: A swirling pattern of five colors somewhere on the body
grants: Balance Sense - The blessed perceives imbalances in power, emotion, and reality
Adaptive Resistance - The blessed gradually becomes resistant to any repeated attack
Convergence Step - The blessed can briefly exist in multiple places at once
Harmony's Favor - The blessed is treated as neutral by all factions, able to pass through any territory

troops.name: Konron-Senshi
troops.description: The Konron-Senshi are beings who have embraced the fundamental chaos at the heart of existence. They understand that order is temporary, that rules are illusions, and that true power comes from accepting the infinite possibilities of each moment.

physical_appearance.features: Whatever is most useful at the moment
physical_appearance.eyes: Usually visible, calm and knowing despite the chaos

troops.lore: The Konron-Senshi are recruited from among those who have achieved enlightenment regarding the nature of reality—who understand that the universe is fundamentally chaotic and that order is a temporary illusion we impose upon it.

passive.name: Chaotic Form
passive.description: The Konron-Senshi's constantly shifting form makes them difficult to target. Attacks against them have a chance to miss entirely, and even successful hits might strike a less vulnerable area.

basic_skills.name: Chaos Strike
basic_skills.description: An attack whose damage type (physical, elemental, spiritual) changes each time, making it hard to defend against.

basic_skills.name: Shift
basic_skills.description: The warrior briefly shifts form, becoming untargetable and reappearing elsewhere.

special_skills.name: Probability Manipulation
special_skills.description: The warrior slightly alters probability in their favor, making their next attack critical and the enemy's next attack miss.

special_skills.name: Reality Flicker
special_skills.description: The warrior exists in multiple places simultaneously for a moment, attacking all nearby enemies.

special_skills.name: Chaos Shield
special_skills.description: Creates a barrier of pure chaos that absorbs damage and reflects a random portion back as a random damage type.

unique_skill.name: Form of Possibility
unique_skill.description: The warrior temporarily becomes all possibilities simultaneously, gaining the abilities of any form they choose and able to switch between them at will.

ultimate_skill.name: Chaos Unleashed
ultimate_skill.description: The warrior releases the full chaos within them, creating a field where reality breaks down. Enemies within experience random effects: damage, healing, transformation, teleportation, time loops. The warrior cannot control what happens but is immune to the effects themselves.

troops.name: Jikū-Senshi
troops.description: The Jikū-Senshi are beings who have mastered the manipulation of space and time, allowing them to exist in multiple moments simultaneously and to be wherever they are needed most.

physical_appearance.features: Constantly flickering between past and future versions
physical_appearance.skin: Pale, with occasional moments of transparency
physical_appearance.aura: Faint distortion like heat haze, but wrong

troops.lore: The Jikū-Senshi are rare even among the Convergence's forces, requiring a specific combination of natural talent and rigorous training. Candidates must first achieve perfect awareness of the present moment, then learn to extend that awareness into the past and future.

passive.name: Temporal Awareness
passive.description: The Jikū-Senshi perceives all possible futures simultaneously, allowing them to automatically evade attacks they see coming. They cannot be surprised, and their attacks always strike where the enemy will be, not where they are.

basic_skills.name: Temporal Slash
basic_skills.description: An attack that strikes the enemy in past, present, and future simultaneously, dealing triple damage.

basic_skills.name: Time Step
basic_skills.description: The warrior briefly steps outside the timestream, becoming untargetable and able to reposition.

special_skills.name: Time Slow
special_skills.description: The warrior slows time in an area, making allies faster and enemies slower relative to the outside world.

special_skills.name: Future Sight
special_skills.description: The warrior sees one possible future and can warn allies, granting them a chance to evade the next attack.

special_skills.name: Past Echo
special_skills.description: The warrior summons an echo of themselves from one second ago to attack again.

unique_skill.name: Temporal Loop
unique_skill.description: The warrior traps an enemy in a short time loop, forcing them to repeat the same actions while taking damage each cycle.

ultimate_skill.name: Timestream Severance
ultimate_skill.description: The warrior cuts an enemy's connection to their own timeline, temporarily removing them from existence. While severed, the enemy cannot act, cannot be targeted, and does not exist. When they return, they have no memory of the intervening time.

troops.name: Gensō-Senshi
troops.description: The Gensō-Senshi are masters of perception, able to create illusions so powerful that they become indistinguishable from reality. They understand that all of existence is, in a sense, an illusion—a shared dream that we all agree to call reality.

physical_appearance.features: Whatever they wish you to perceive
physical_appearance.aura: Subtle wrongness that only the perceptive notice
physical_appearance.eyes: Often the only clue—they never match the rest of the illusion

troops.lore: The Gensō-Senshi began as tricksters, deceivers, and artists—beings who understood that perception is reality and that changing how something is seen changes what it is. They honed their skills over centuries, learning to create illusions that could fool gods and mortals alike.

passive.name: Unreliable Target
passive.description: The Gensō-Senshi constantly projects an illusion of being somewhere else. Attacks against them have a high chance to hit the illusion instead of the real warrior.

basic_skills.name: Phantom Strike
basic_skills.description: An illusory copy of the warrior attacks, dealing real damage if believed in.

basic_skills.name: Veil
basic_skills.description: The warrior becomes invisible for a short time.

special_skills.name: Mass Illusion
special_skills.description: Creates an illusory army that enemies must waste time attacking.

special_skills.name: Reality Shift
special_skills.description: Temporarily changes how an area is perceived, making allies look like enemies and enemies look like allies.

special_skills.name: Nightmare
special_skills.description: Creates an illusion personalized to an enemy's greatest fear, stunning them.

unique_skill.name: Illusion Breaker
unique_skill.description: The warrior strips away all illusions in an area, revealing truth. This can expose hidden enemies, dispel buffs, and reveal weaknesses.

ultimate_skill.name: Dream Weaving
ultimate_skill.description: The warrior temporarily replaces reality with a dream of their choosing. For a duration, they control what enemies perceive, see, and experience. They cannot directly harm enemies in this state, but they can make enemies harm themselves or each other.

monster_hierarchy.name: Normal
monster_hierarchy.description: Normal monsters are the common creatures of Zerox Enon—the wolves that hunt in the forests, the spirits that haunt abandoned shrines, the constructs that guard ancient tombs. They possess basic instincts, minimal intelligence, and powers that are easily understood and countered.

monsters.name: Kappa
monsters.habitat: Rivers, lakes, ponds throughout Zerox Enon
monsters.physical_description: The Kappa is one of the most recognizable yokai in Zerox Enon, appearing as a humanoid creature roughly the size of a child. Its body is covered in scales that range from green to blue, and it has a turtle-like shell on its back. Its face is monkey-like with a pointed mouth, and its hands and feet are webbed. The most distinctive feature is the sara (dish) on top of its head, which holds water—the source of its power and life.
monsters.lore: Kappa are river spirits that have existed since the first humans settled near water. They are mischievous rather than evil, known for pulling people into rivers, stealing crops, and occasionally drowning livestock. However, they also help with irrigation and will return favors done for them. The key to dealing with a Kappa is politeness—if you bow to a Kappa, it will bow back, and water will spill from its dish, weakening it.

passive.name: Water Source
passive.description: The Kappa's power depends on the water in its head-dish. While the dish contains water, the Kappa has enhanced strength and regeneration. If the dish is emptied, the Kappa becomes significantly weaker.

basic_skills.name: Water Gun
basic_skills.description: The Kappa spits a high-pressure stream of water, knocking back and damaging a single target.

basic_skills.name: Grapple
basic_skills.description: The Kappa grabs a target and attempts to pull them into water.

special_skills.name: Sumo Slam
special_skills.description: The Kappa uses its opponent's momentum against them, throwing them with surprising force.

special_skills.name: Cucumber Lure
special_skills.description: The Kappa creates an illusory cucumber (its favorite food) to distract enemies.

special_skills.name: Water Shield
special_skills.description: Creates a barrier of swirling water that absorbs damage.

unique_skill.name: Polite Bow
unique_skill.description: The Kappa bows deeply, spilling water from its dish. If an enemy bows back, the Kappa is confused and cannot act for a moment. If they don't, the Kappa becomes angry and attacks with increased ferocity.

ultimate_skill.name: River's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: The Kappa calls upon the river itself, creating a flood that damages and sweeps away all enemies in an area.

monsters.name: Tsuchigumo
monsters.habitat: Mountains, caves, underground throughout Zerox Enon
monsters.physical_description: The Tsuchigumo is a massive spider, easily the size of a small horse, with a body covered in bristly hair the color of earth and stone. Its eight eyes glow with a faint red light, and its fangs drip with venom that can paralyze prey instantly. Its legs are thick and powerful, capable of digging through solid rock. Unlike ordinary spiders, Tsuchigumo do not spin webs—they create tunnels, collapsing them on prey and then digging through the rubble to feed.
monsters.lore: Tsuchigumo are ancient creatures, said to be the transformed spirits of warriors who died in mountain battles and were never given proper burial. They haunt the mountains where they fell, attacking travelers who wander too close to their graves. Some Tsuchigumo have grown to enormous size over centuries, becoming mountain spirits in their own right.

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.description: The Tsuchigumo's chitin is as hard as rock, granting it high resistance to physical damage. However, it is vulnerable to earth-based magic, which can cause its body to crack.

basic_skills.name: Venom Bite
basic_skills.description: A bite that deals damage and applies a paralyzing venom.

basic_skills.name: Leg Sweep
basic_skills.description: The spider sweeps its powerful legs, knocking back nearby enemies.

special_skills.name: Tunnel
special_skills.description: The Tsuchigumo digs into the ground, emerging elsewhere and surprising enemies.

special_skills.name: Rock Shower
special_skills.description: The spider kicks up stones that rain down on enemies.

special_skills.name: Earth Shield
special_skills.description: Creates a barrier of packed earth that absorbs damage.

unique_skill.name: Collapse
unique_skill.description: The Tsuchigumo causes the ground to collapse beneath enemies, trapping them in a pit.

ultimate_skill.name: Mountain's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: The Tsuchigumo calls upon the mountain itself, causing rockslides and earthquakes that devastate a large area.

monsters.name: Karakasa
monsters.habitat: Urban areas, roadsides, anywhere discarded items accumulate
monsters.physical_description: The Karakasa is a tsukumogami—a spirit that inhabits a discarded object that has reached its 100th birthday. It appears as a single-legged umbrella with one eye, a long tongue, and wooden geta sandals on its single foot. It hops about, often startling travelers. Its body is the umbrella itself, the paper sometimes torn and the ribs broken. When it opens, it can reveal a mouth lined with sharp teeth.
monsters.lore: Karakasa are among the most common tsukumogami, as umbrellas are frequently discarded. They are said to be playful rather than malicious, enjoying nothing more than popping open suddenly to scare passersby. However, if provoked, they can become dangerous, their paper edges sharp as knives.

passive.name: Paper Body
passive.description: The Karakasa's paper body makes it light and difficult to hit, but vulnerable to fire and water.

basic_skills.name: Open Slam
basic_skills.description: The Karakasa opens suddenly, startling an enemy and dealing minor damage.

basic_skills.name: Hop
basic_skills.description: The Karakasa hops away, evading attacks.

special_skills.name: Paper Cut
special_skills.description: The Karakasa's edges sharpen, dealing slashing damage.

special_skills.name: Spook
special_skills.description: The Karakasa pops open in an enemy's face, stunning them briefly.

special_skills.name: Glide
special_skills.description: The Karakasa opens and glides on the wind, moving quickly.

unique_skill.name: Possess
unique_skill.description: The Karakasa briefly possesses another umbrella, using it to attack.

ultimate_skill.name: Umbrella Storm
ultimate_skill.description: The Karakasa multiplies into dozens of copies, all attacking simultaneously before reforming.

monster_hierarchy.name: Rare
monster_hierarchy.description: Rare monsters possess greater power and intelligence than normal creatures. They are often the leaders of normal monster groups, the guardians of important locations, or the results of unusual circumstances.

monsters.name: Nurarihyon
monsters.habitat: Throughout Zerox Enon, wherever yokai gather
monsters.physical_description: The Nurarihyon appears as an elderly man with a elongated, featureless head that resembles a monk's tonsure but is actually a gourd-shaped cranium. He wears traditional robes and carries a staff, and he moves with the slow, deliberate pace of great age. His face, when visible, is wrinkled and wise, with eyes that have seen centuries.
monsters.lore: The Nurarihyon is said to be the original yokai, the first spirit to emerge from the primordial chaos. He has existed since before the gods, before the Celestial Court, before the Shadow Spirit Court. He has seen everything and forgotten nothing.

passive.name: Ancient Wisdom
passive.description: The Nurarihyon's centuries of experience allow him to predict enemy actions with frightening accuracy. Attacks against him have a high chance to miss, and he always seems to be where danger isn't.

basic_skills.name: Staff Tap
basic_skills.description: A light tap that somehow carries the weight of centuries, dealing spiritual damage.

basic_skills.name: Tea Offering
basic_skills.description: The Nurarihyon offers tea, which can either heal an ally or confuse an enemy.

special_skills.name: Elder's Command
special_skills.description: The Nurarihyon speaks a single word, and lesser yokai must obey. He can order them to attack, defend, or cease hostilities.

special_skills.name: Memory Sip
special_skills.description: He sips tea and experiences a memory, which he can then share with others or use to gain insight.

special_skills.name: Comfortable Spot
special_skills.description: Wherever the Nurarihyon sits becomes a place of peace, healing all who rest there.

unique_skill.name: Yokai Summit
unique_skill.description: The Nurarihyon calls a gathering of all yokai in the area, forcing them to pause their activities and listen. This can stop ongoing battles or create opportunities.

ultimate_skill.name: Primordial Wisdom
ultimate_skill.description: The Nurarihyon channels his ancient knowledge, temporarily understanding all things. During this time, he cannot be deceived, cannot be surprised, and his advice is absolute truth.

monsters.name: Kodama
monsters.habitat: Ancient forests throughout Zerox Enon
monsters.physical_description: Kodama are small spirits that inhabit ancient trees, appearing as tiny humanoid figures made of pale light. They have no distinct features—just vaguely human shapes with two brighter points for eyes. They drift among the branches of their host trees, occasionally appearing to travelers who treat the forest with respect.
monsters.lore: Kodama are the spirits of trees, born when a tree reaches a certain age and becomes aware of its own existence. They are shy, gentle creatures, watching travelers from the branches and occasionally leaving offerings for those who show respect. Harm a Kodama's tree, and you harm the Kodama.

passive.name: Forest Sense
passive.description: Kodama are aware of everything happening in their forest. They cannot be surprised, and they can communicate with all plants and animals.

basic_skills.name: Glow
basic_skills.description: The Kodama emits a soft light, revealing hidden things.

basic_skills.name: Whisper
basic_skills.description: The Kodama whispers secrets, providing information or causing confusion.

special_skills.name: Branch Whip
special_skills.description: The Kodama causes branches to whip at enemies.

special_skills.name: Root Bind
special_skills.description: Roots burst from the ground, holding enemies in place.

special_skills.name: Healing Light
special_skills.description: The Kodama's glow heals allies.

unique_skill.name: Forest's Curse
unique_skill.description: The Kodama curses an enemy, causing them to become lost and confused in the forest.

ultimate_skill.name: Forest Army
ultimate_skill.description: The Kodama calls upon all the spirits of the forest, causing the very woods to attack enemies.

monsters.name: Kamaitachi
monsters.habitat: Grasslands, fields, anywhere with tall grass
monsters.physical_description: The Kamaitachi are a trio of weasel-like yokai that ride on whirlwinds and carry razor-sharp sickles. The first weasel knocks victims down, the second cuts them with its sickle, and the third applies medicine to the wounds—ensuring that the victim feels pain but doesn't die. They appear as small, sleek weasels with sickles for front claws, moving so fast they're nearly invisible.
monsters.lore: Kamaitachi are wind spirits that take the form of weasels. They delight in surprising travelers, cutting them with their sickles, and then watching them try to understand what happened. The wounds they inflict are painless at first but begin to hurt moments later—the effect of the medicine the third sibling applies.

passive.name: Wind Speed
passive.description: Kamaitachi move at incredible speed, making them difficult to hit. They also ignore movement penalties from terrain.

basic_skills.name: Sickle Slash
basic_skills.description: A fast slashing attack that deals damage and applies a bleed effect.

basic_skills.name: Whirlwind Dodge
basic_skills.description: The Kamaitachi turns into wind, evading attacks and repositioning.

special_skills.name: Triple Strike
special_skills.description: All three siblings attack in sequence, dealing increasing damage.

special_skills.name: Wind Ride
special_skills.description: The Kamaitachi ride a whirlwind, becoming untargetable and moving quickly.

special_skills.name: Medicine Application
special_skills.description: The third sibling applies medicine, which can heal allies or cause delayed damage to enemies.

unique_skill.name: Invisible Cut
unique_skill.description: The Kamaitachi attack so fast that enemies don't realize they've been hit until later, when damage accumulates.

ultimate_skill.name: Windstorm Slash
ultimate_skill.description: The Kamaitachi create a tornado of slicing wind, damaging all enemies in a large area repeatedly.

monster_hierarchy.name: Special
monster_hierarchy.description: Special monsters possess unique abilities and often serve as guardians of important locations or as lieutenants to more powerful beings. They are intelligent, capable of complex strategies, and often have followers of their own.

monsters.name: Tengu
monsters.habitat: Deep mountains, ancient forests throughout Zerox Enon
monsters.physical_description: Tengu appear as humanoids with long noses and feathered wings. Their skin ranges from red to blue, and they wear the robes of mountain ascetics, complete with small black hats and geta sandals. In their hands, they carry fans made of feathers—their primary weapons and tools of magic. The Karasu-Tengu (crow tengu) have bird-like features—beaks instead of noses, feathers covering their bodies, and more pronounced wings.
monsters.lore: Tengu were once considered evil spirits, demons that terrorized travelers and kidnapped children. Over time, their reputation softened, and they became known as protectors of the mountains, teachers of martial arts, and tricksters who punished the arrogant. Tengu are masters of combat, particularly swordsmanship and the use of the war fan.

passive.name: Wind Walker
passive.description: Tengu can fly and are unaffected by wind-based effects. They move silently and leave no tracks.

basic_skills.name: Fan Gust
basic_skills.description: The Tengu fans its wings or war fan, creating a gust that damages and knocks back enemies.

basic_skills.name: Sword Strike
basic_skills.description: A precise sword strike that deals damage and can disarm.

special_skills.name: Magic Fan
special_skills.description: The Tengu's fan creates illusions, confuses enemies, or controls wind.

special_skills.name: Martial Teaching
special_skills.description: The Tengu briefly teaches an ally a technique, granting them a temporary ability.

special_skills.name: Mist Walk
special_skills.description: The Tengu disappears into mist, becoming untargetable.

unique_skill.name: Challenge
unique_skill.description: The Tengu challenges an enemy to single combat. If accepted, both are bound to fight without interference. If refused, the enemy is shamed and weakened.

ultimate_skill.name: Mountain's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: The Tengu calls upon the mountain, causing rockslides and storms that devastate a large area.

monsters.name: Yuki-Onna
monsters.habitat: Snowy mountains, blizzards, frozen wastelands
monsters.physical_description: The Yuki-Onna is a spirit of winter, appearing as a breathtakingly beautiful woman with skin as pale as snow, hair as black as a winter night, and lips the color of frozen blood. She wears a white kimono that seems to blend with the snow around her, and she leaves no footprints as she walks. Her eyes are deep and cold, holding the loneliness of eternal winter.
monsters.lore: Yuki-Onna are the spirits of women who died in snowstorms, their souls unable to find peace. They wander the mountains where they perished, sometimes luring travelers to their deaths, sometimes saving them. Their behavior is unpredictable, driven by the loneliness and sorrow of their deaths.

passive.name: Frozen Heart
passive.description: The Yuki-Onna is immune to cold damage and constantly radiates cold, slowly freezing enemies near her. Water near her turns to ice.

basic_skills.name: Ice Breath
basic_skills.description: The Yuki-Onna exhales a cloud of freezing air, damaging and slowing enemies.

basic_skills.name: Frozen Touch
basic_skills.description: Her touch deals cold damage and can freeze a target solid.

special_skills.name: Blizzard
special_skills.description: Creates a localized snowstorm that damages and blinds enemies.

special_skills.name: Ice Mirror
special_skills.description: Creates a mirror of ice that reflects attacks.

special_skills.name: Snow Cloak
special_skills.description: The Yuki-Onna becomes nearly invisible in snow.

unique_skill.name: Fatal Embrace
unique_skill.description: The Yuki-Onna embraces a target, freezing them solid while draining their warmth to heal herself.

ultimate_skill.name: Eternal Winter
ultimate_skill.description: The Yuki-Onna unleashes the full fury of winter, freezing an entire area solid. Enemies caught are damaged and trapped in ice.

monsters.name: Nue
monsters.habitat: Dark forests, mountains, near places of death
monsters.physical_description: The Nue is a chimera with the head of a monkey, the body of a tanuki (racoon dog), the legs of a tiger, and the tail of a serpent. Its body is covered in black scales rather than fur, and its eyes glow with malevolent intelligence. When it moves, each part seems to act independently, creating a disturbing, disjointed motion. It is large, easily the size of a horse.
monsters.lore: Nue are born from concentrated negative emotions—fear, despair, hatred—gathering in places of death or great suffering. They are omens of disaster, and their appearance often precedes plagues, wars, or natural catastrophes. Killing a Nue is difficult, as its composite nature makes it resistant to most attacks.

passive.name: Composite Body
passive.description: The Nue's different parts act independently. It can make multiple attacks per turn, and damaging one part doesn't affect the others. However, each part can be targeted separately.

basic_skills.name: Monkey Bite
basic_skills.description: The monkey head bites, dealing damage and applying a disease.

basic_skills.name: Tiger Claw
basic_skills.description: The tiger legs slash, dealing damage and applying bleed.

basic_skills.name: Serpent Strike
basic_skills.description: The serpent tail strikes, dealing poison damage.

special_skills.name: Disease Cloud
special_skills.description: The Nue emits a cloud of pestilence that damages and sickens enemies.

special_skills.name: Omen of Death
special_skills.description: The Nue's cry causes fear and weakness in all who hear it.

special_skills.name: Chaos Body
special_skills.description: The Nue's parts attack randomly, making its movements unpredictable.

unique_skill.name: Misfortune
unique_skill.description: The Nue curses a target, causing them to experience bad luck—attacks miss, items break, allies accidentally harm them.

ultimate_skill.name: Disaster's Arrival
ultimate_skill.description: The Nue calls forth a localized disaster—earthquake, plague, storm—that devastates a large area.

monster_hierarchy.name: Epic
monster_hierarchy.description: Epic monsters are legendary creatures, known throughout Zerox Enon. They possess great power, intelligence, and often serve as major antagonists or guardians. Defeating an epic monster is a feat worthy of songs and stories.

monsters.name: Ōtake-Maru
monsters.habitat: Bamboo forests, particularly in Shinkage
monsters.physical_description: Ōtake-Maru appears as a giant made entirely of bamboo, standing over thirty feet tall. His body is composed of thick bamboo stalks woven together, his arms are massive bamboo clubs, and his head is a cluster of bamboo leaves surrounding a single, glowing eye. When he moves, he makes the sound of a forest swaying in the wind—creaking, rustling, and the occasional sharp crack of breaking stalks.
monsters.lore: Ōtake-Maru was once a simple bamboo cutter who loved the forest where he worked. He treated the bamboo with respect, always giving thanks for each stalk he cut and never taking more than he needed. When he died, the bamboo forest he had protected for so long refused to let him go, and his spirit merged with the plants to become their eternal guardian.

passive.name: Forest's Strength
passive.description: Ōtake-Maru is stronger in bamboo forests, where he can draw power from the plants around him. He regenerates health rapidly and his attacks are enhanced.

basic_skills.name: Bamboo Slam
basic_skills.description: He slams his massive club-arms down, creating a shockwave.

basic_skills.name: Stalk Spear
basic_skills.description: Bamboo stalks shoot from the ground, impaling enemies.

special_skills.name: Forest Embrace
special_skills.description: Bamboo wraps around enemies, holding them in place and slowly crushing them.

special_skills.name: Leaf Storm
special_skills.description: Razor-sharp bamboo leaves whirl around him, damaging all nearby.

special_skills.name: Root Healing
special_skills.description: He sinks roots into the ground, rapidly regenerating health.

unique_skill.name: Judgment
unique_skill.description: Ōtake-Maru judges a target based on their treatment of nature. The guilty take massive damage; the innocent are healed.

ultimate_skill.name: Bamboo Forest Manifestation
ultimate_skill.description: Ōtake-Maru calls forth an entire bamboo forest, transforming the battlefield into his domain where he has absolute control.

monsters.name: Umi-Bōzu
monsters.habitat: Oceans, particularly around Kishima and Tenryuku
monsters.physical_description: The Umi-Bōzu appears as a massive humanoid figure rising from the sea, its body composed of dark, churning water. It has a round, bald head like a monk's and two glowing eyes that pierce the darkness of storms. Its size varies—sometimes as tall as a ship's mast, sometimes towering over islands. When it speaks, its voice is the sound of crashing waves.
monsters.lore: Umi-Bōzu are said to be the spirits of drowned monks, their souls unable to find peace and instead merging with the sea. They appear during storms, towering over ships and demanding answers from the crews. Those who answer respectfully may be spared; those who show fear or disrespect are dragged beneath the waves.

passive.name: Water Form
passive.description: The Umi-Bōzu's body is made of water, making it immune to physical damage. Only magical attacks can harm it. It can also reform if partially dispersed.

basic_skills.name: Wave Slam
basic_skills.description: Creates a massive wave that damages and knocks back enemies.

basic_skills.name: Drowning Grasp
basic_skills.description: Watery hands reach up to grab and drown enemies.

special_skills.name: Storm Call
special_skills.description: Summons a localized storm with lightning and heavy rain.

special_skills.name: Ship Breaker
special_skills.description: Focuses on ships or large structures, dealing massive damage.

special_skills.name: Whirlpool
special_skills.description: Creates a whirlpool that pulls in and damages enemies.

unique_skill.name: Questioning
unique_skill.description: The Umi-Bōzu asks a question. Those who answer truthfully may be spared; those who lie are attacked with increased ferocity.

ultimate_skill.name: Tsunami
ultimate_skill.description: The Umi-Bōzu calls forth a massive tsunami that devastates an entire coastline or fleet.

monsters.name: Shutendōji
monsters.habitat: Mountains, particularly on Hōraisan's lower slopes
monsters.physical_description: Shutendōji appears as a giant of a man, easily fifteen feet tall, with red skin, long wild hair, and a face that is both handsome and terrifying. He wears elaborate robes befitting a noble, but they are always disheveled, stained with sake and blood. In one hand, he carries a massive sake cup; in the other, a sword as tall as a normal man.
monsters.lore: Shutendōji was once a human bandit who discovered a magical sake that transformed him into an oni. He gathered a band of followers and established a fortress in the mountains, from which they raided nearby villages. In Zerox Enon, Shutendōji is not a single being but a title—the leader of any particularly powerful oni band.

passive.name: Drunken Stance
passive.description: Shutendōji's movements become unpredictable when he drinks. Attacks against him have a chance to miss, and his own attacks gain bonus damage.

basic_skills.name: Sake Splash
basic_skills.description: Throws sake that burns (literally and figuratively), dealing damage and disorienting.

basic_skills.name: Oni Slash
basic_skills.description: A powerful sword strike that deals heavy damage.

special_skills.name: Drunken Frenzy
special_skills.description: Shutendōji drinks deeply and enters a frenzy, attacking randomly with increased power.

special_skills.name: Bandit Call
special_skills.description: Summons lesser oni to fight for him.

special_skills.name: Fortress Defense
special_skills.description: Creates a barrier of oni energy that absorbs damage.

unique_skill.name: Invitation to Drink
unique_skill.description: Shutendōji offers an enemy a drink. If they accept, they are poisoned and weakened. If they refuse, he becomes enraged.

ultimate_skill.name: Oni Lord's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: Shutendōji unleashes his full power, growing even larger and attacking with devastating force.

monster_hierarchy.name: Legend
monster_hierarchy.description: Legend monsters are beings of immense power, known throughout Zerox Enon and beyond. They are often the subjects of epic poems and songs, their deeds recorded in history. Defeating a legend monster requires the combined efforts of heroes or the direct intervention of gods.

monsters.name: Yamata-no-Orochi
monsters.habitat: The ancient forests of Shinkage, near the Abyss of the Underworld
monsters.physical_description: Yamata-no-Orochi is a serpent of impossible size, its body coiling through valleys and its eight heads reaching toward the sky like separate mountains. Each head is the size of a temple, with eyes that glow like molten gold and mouths filled with rows of sword-length teeth. Its scales are dark green, nearly black, and each one is the size of a shield. When it moves, the ground shakes, and when all eight heads roar simultaneously, the sound can be heard for miles.
monsters.lore: Yamata-no-Orochi is one of the oldest beings in Zerox Enon, predating even the Celestial Court. According to legend, it terrorized the land for centuries, demanding yearly sacrifices of young women, until the hero Susano-o defeated it by getting it drunk on sake and then cutting off its heads one by one. In Zerox Enon, the serpent was not killed but merely wounded, and it retreated to the deepest forests to heal.

passive.name: Eight Lives
passive.description: Each of Yamata-no-Orochi's heads must be defeated separately. As long as at least one head remains, the serpent can regenerate lost heads over time.

basic_skills.name: Fire Breath
basic_skills.description: Head 1 breathes massive streams of flame.

basic_skills.name: Ice Breath
basic_skills.description: Head 2 exhales freezing mist.

basic_skills.name: Lightning Strike
basic_skills.description: Head 3 calls down thunderbolts.

basic_skills.name: Venom Spray
basic_skills.description: Head 4 sprays venom.

basic_skills.name: Earthquake
basic_skills.description: Head 5 causes earthquakes.
