basic_skills.name: Tornado
basic_skills.description: Head 6 creates tornadoes.

basic_skills.name: Shadow Drain
basic_skills.description: Head 7 emits shadows that drain life.

basic_skills.name: Holy Beam
basic_skills.description: Head 8 fires beams of holy energy.

special_skills.name: Coordinated Strike
special_skills.description: Multiple heads attack simultaneously, targeting different enemies.

special_skills.name: Body Slam
special_skills.description: The serpent's massive body crashes down, crushing everything in an area.

special_skills.name: Regeneration
special_skills.description: If any head remains, the serpent regenerates lost heads over time.

unique_skill.name: Primordial Roar
unique_skill.description: All eight heads roar together, creating a shockwave that damages and fears all who hear it.

ultimate_skill.name: Apocalypse
ultimate_skill.description: Yamata-no-Orochi unleashes the full power of all eight heads simultaneously, creating a localized apocalypse that devastates everything within miles.

monsters.name: Hakutaku
monsters.habitat: Swamps and marshes throughout Zerox Enon
monsters.threat_level: Variable (benevolent if respected, deadly if provoked)
monsters.physical_description: Hakutaku appears as a magnificent white creature with the body of a lion, the face of a human (often with a serene expression), and multiple eyes covering its body. It has nine tails, each one tipped with a tuft of golden fur, and its mane flows like mist. Despite its fearsome appearance, its presence brings peace and clarity to those nearby.
monsters.lore: Hakutaku is a spirit of wisdom and prophecy, said to appear only during times of great change or crisis. It knows all things—past, present, and future—and can share this knowledge with those it deems worthy. According to legend, Hakutaku was once a scholar who achieved enlightenment and transformed into this form.

passive.name: All-Knowing
passive.description: Hakutaku perceives everything within its domain. It cannot be surprised, cannot be deceived, and always knows the true nature of any being it encounters.

basic_skills.name: Wisdom's Touch
basic_skills.description: A touch that grants understanding, which can heal confusion or reveal truth.

basic_skills.name: Tail Sweep
basic_skills.description: A sweep of its nine tails that deals minimal damage but reveals weaknesses.

special_skills.name: Prophecy
special_skills.description: Hakutaku speaks a prophecy, which may come true immediately or in the future. Enemies who hear prophecies about themselves may be affected.

special_skills.name: Reveal Truth
special_skills.description: Hakutaku strips away all illusions and deceptions in an area.

special_skills.name: Blessing of Clarity
special_skills.description: Grants an ally perfect understanding, temporarily boosting all abilities.

unique_skill.name: Future Sight
unique_skill.description: Hakutaku sees one possible future and can warn allies, allowing them to avoid disasters.

ultimate_skill.name: Wisdom's Judgment
ultimate_skill.description: Hakutaku judges all beings in an area based on their wisdom and understanding. The wise are blessed; the foolish are cursed.

monsters.name: Byakko
monsters.habitat: The western mountains of Tenryuku
monsters.physical_description: Byakko is one of the Four Celestial Beasts, the guardian of the West. It appears as a massive white tiger, larger than any natural predator, with stripes of silver and gold that seem to shift and flow. Its eyes are the color of autumn leaves, and its roar can be heard across continents. When it moves, wind follows, and when it attacks, its claws leave trails of light.
monsters.lore: Byakko is one of the Four Celestial Beasts, ancient guardians assigned to protect the four cardinal directions. It has existed since the dawn of time, watching over the West and ensuring that chaos does not spread from that direction. Byakko is associated with autumn, with metal, and with the virtue of righteousness.

passive.name: Celestial Guardian
passive.description: Byakko is immune to corruption and cannot be controlled or influenced by dark forces. Its attacks deal bonus damage to chaotic and evil beings.

basic_skills.name: Tiger Claw
basic_skills.description: A slash that leaves trails of light, dealing damage and applying a mark.

basic_skills.name: Wind Step
basic_skills.description: Byakko moves with the wind, appearing elsewhere.

special_skills.name: Autumn's Wrath
special_skills.description: Byakko calls upon autumn, causing leaves to fall that cut like blades.

special_skills.name: Metal Roar
special_skills.description: A roar that sounds like crashing metal, damaging and stunning.

special_skills.name: Guardian's Shield
special_skills.description: Creates a barrier of celestial energy that protects allies.

unique_skill.name: Judgment Claw
unique_skill.description: Byakko judges a target. The guilty take massive damage; the innocent are unharmed.

ultimate_skill.name: Western Gate
ultimate_skill.description: Byakko opens the Western Gate of Heaven, calling forth celestial energy that devastates enemies and blesses allies.

monster_hierarchy.name: Myth
monster_hierarchy.description: Myth monsters are beings of such power that they are often mistaken for gods. They have existed since the earliest days of Zerox Enon and have shaped the course of history through their actions. Defeating a myth monster is nearly impossible without divine intervention.

monsters.name: Seiryū
monsters.habitat: The eastern seas of Tenryuku
monsters.physical_description: Seiryū is one of the Four Celestial Beasts, the guardian of the East. It appears as an azure dragon of breathtaking beauty, its scales the color of a spring sky, its horns branching like ancient trees, and its eyes the deep blue of the ocean. It is immense—when fully extended, its body can wrap around mountains, and its flight casts shadows over entire cities. Unlike other dragons, Seiryū has no wings. It flies through the power of its own will, swimming through the air as easily as through water.
monsters.lore: Seiryū is the guardian of the East, associated with spring, with wood, and with the virtue of benevolence. It has existed since before the Celestial Court, one of the original forces of order in the universe. It rarely intervenes directly in mortal affairs, but when it does, its actions are always aimed at preserving balance and promoting growth.

passive.name: Life Giver
passive.description: Seiryū's presence causes life to flourish. Allies near it regenerate health rapidly, and plants grow to aid in battle.

basic_skills.name: Azure Breath
basic_skills.description: Breathes a stream of pure water that heals allies and damages enemies.

basic_skills.name: Tail Sweep
basic_skills.description: A sweep of its massive tail that damages and knocks back.

special_skills.name: Spring Storm
special_skills.description: Creates a gentle storm that heals allies and damages enemies over time.

special_skills.name: Wood's Embrace
special_skills.description: Trees and plants rise to bind enemies and protect allies.

special_skills.name: Dragon's Wisdom
special_skills.description: Seiryū shares its ancient knowledge, granting allies insight.

unique_skill.name: Rejuvenation
unique_skill.description: Seiryū restores an ally or area to perfect condition, healing all damage and removing all corruption.

ultimate_skill.name: Eastern Gate
ultimate_skill.description: Seiryū opens the Eastern Gate of Heaven, calling forth the energy of spring that blesses allies and curses enemies.

monsters.name: Genbu
monsters.habitat: The northern mountains of Shinkage
monsters.physical_description: Genbu is one of the Four Celestial Beasts, the guardian of the North. It appears as a massive tortoise with a serpent coiled around its body. The tortoise part is immense, its shell like a small mountain, covered in ancient runes that glow with protective energy. The serpent has its own head, which rises from the tortoise's back, watching in all directions with piercing eyes.
monsters.lore: Genbu is the guardian of the North, associated with winter, with water, and with the virtue of wisdom. It represents endurance, protection, and the strength that comes from patience. It has existed since before memory, watching the ages pass from its northern home.

passive.name: Absolute Defense
passive.description: Genbu's shell provides near-immunity to damage. Attacks against it are reduced by 90%, and it regenerates any damage taken over time.

basic_skills.name: Shell Slam
basic_skills.description: Genbu slams its massive shell down, creating an earthquake.

basic_skills.name: Serpent Strike
basic_skills.description: The serpent strikes with lightning speed, dealing poison damage.

special_skills.name: Protective Dome
special_skills.description: Genbu creates a dome of energy that protects all allies inside.

special_skills.name: Winter's Chill
special_skills.description: The serpent breathes freezing mist, damaging and slowing enemies.

special_skills.name: Ancient Runes
special_skills.description: The runes on Genbu's shell glow, providing various buffs to allies.

unique_skill.name: Endurance
unique_skill.description: Genbu shares its endurance with an ally, granting them temporary invulnerability.

ultimate_skill.name: Northern Gate
ultimate_skill.description: Genbu opens the Northern Gate of Heaven, calling forth the energy of winter that protects allies and freezes enemies.

monsters.name: Suzaku
monsters.habitat: The southern volcanoes of Hōraisan
monsters.physical_description: Suzaku is one of the Four Celestial Beasts, the guardian of the South. It appears as a magnificent phoenix, its feathers the color of living flame—red, orange, and gold that shift and flicker like fire. Its eyes are like burning coals, and its cry sounds like the crackling of a great fire. When it flies, it leaves a trail of flame, and when it lands, the ground itself may catch fire.
monsters.lore: Suzaku is the guardian of the South, associated with summer, with fire, and with the virtue of propriety. It represents passion, transformation, and the power of renewal. Like all phoenixes, Suzaku can be reborn from its own ashes, making it effectively immortal.

passive.name: Purifying Flame
passive.description: Suzaku's flames deal bonus damage to corrupted beings and heal pure beings. Allies near it are slowly cleansed of negative effects.

basic_skills.name: Flame Wing
basic_skills.description: A sweep of its burning wings that damages and burns enemies.

basic_skills.name: Phoenix Cry
basic_skills.description: A cry that inspires allies and fears enemies.

special_skills.name: Summer's Heat
special_skills.description: Intensifies the heat in an area, damaging enemies over time.

special_skills.name: Rebirth Flame
special_skills.description: Suzaku can heal allies by touching them with its flame.

special_skills.name: Fire Shield
special_skills.description: Creates a shield of flame around itself or an ally.

unique_skill.name: Purification
unique_skill.description: Suzaku's flame burns away all corruption from a target or area.

ultimate_skill.name: Southern Gate
ultimate_skill.description: Suzaku opens the Southern Gate of Heaven, calling forth purifying flame that burns enemies and heals allies.

monster_hierarchy.name: Immortal
monster_hierarchy.description: Immortal monsters are beings that cannot die by any conventional means. They have existed since before recorded history and will exist until the end of time. They are often worshiped as gods by lesser beings, though they are distinct from true divinities.

monsters.name: Hōō
monsters.habitat: The highest peaks of Hōraisan
monsters.threat_level: Variable (benevolent to pure, destructive to corrupt)
monsters.physical_description: The Hōō is the king of all birds, a phoenix of breathtaking beauty. Its feathers are every color imaginable, arranged in patterns that shift and flow like living art. Its tail is long and flowing, trailing rainbow colors, and its crest rises like a crown of flame. Its eyes are deep and wise, holding the knowledge of countless rebirths.
monsters.lore: The Hōō is not a single being but a title held by the most powerful phoenix of each age. When the current Hōō feels its time ending, it builds a nest of aromatic wood, sets it on fire, and is consumed—only to rise again from the ashes, reborn and renewed. The Hōō appears only in times of peace and prosperity.

passive.name: Eternal Rebirth
passive.description: If the Hōō is killed, it rises from its own ashes after a time, fully healed. This can only be prevented by destroying its ashes before rebirth completes.

basic_skills.name: Rainbow Feather
basic_skills.description: Fires a feather that deals damage based on the target's alignment (more to evil, less to good).

basic_skills.name: Healing Song
basic_skills.description: A song that heals all who hear it.

special_skills.name: Rebirth Flame
special_skills.description: The Hōō's flame can either destroy or heal, depending on its will.

special_skills.name: Tears of the Phoenix
special_skills.description: Tears that cure any disease or curse.

special_skills.name: Rainbow Trail
special_skills.description: Leaves a trail of light that heals allies and damages enemies.

unique_skill.name: Judgment of Beauty
unique_skill.description: The Hōō judges a target based on their inner beauty. The beautiful are blessed; the ugly are cursed.

ultimate_skill.name: Rebirth
ultimate_skill.description: The Hōō sacrifices itself to fully heal and resurrect all allies, then rises again from its ashes.

monsters.name: Baku
monsters.habitat: The dream realm, occasionally manifesting in Shinsekai
monsters.physical_description: The Baku appears as a strange chimera—body of a bear, trunk of an elephant, eyes of a rhinoceros, tail of an ox, and legs of a tiger. Despite this bizarre combination, it has a certain dignity, moving with the gravity of a creature that understands dreams. Its fur is dark, absorbing light, and its eyes glow softly in darkness.
monsters.lore: The Baku is a spirit of dreams, called upon by those suffering from nightmares. If you wake from a nightmare and call upon the Baku three times, it will come and eat the bad dream, leaving you to sleep peacefully. But the Baku must be treated with respect.

passive.name: Dream Walker
passive.description: The Baku exists simultaneously in the dream realm and the physical world. It can step between them at will and is immune to effects that target only one realm.

basic_skills.name: Nightmare Bite
basic_skills.description: Bites an enemy, consuming their dreams and dealing mental damage.

basic_skills.name: Dream Step
basic_skills.description: Steps into dreams, becoming untargetable.

special_skills.name: Nightmare Feast
special_skills.description: The Baku feasts on nearby nightmares, healing itself and damaging enemies.

special_skills.name: Peaceful Sleep
special_skills.description: Puts an ally into a healing sleep, restoring health over time.

special_skills.name: Dream Trap
special_skills.description: Traps an enemy in a nightmare, stunning them.

unique_skill.name: Call of the Baku
unique_skill.description: The Baku can be called by those in need. When called, it appears instantly, regardless of distance.

ultimate_skill.name: Dream Eater's Banquet
ultimate_skill.description: The Baku consumes all dreams in a large area, damaging enemies and healing allies based on the power of their dreams.

monsters.name: Kirin
monsters.habitat: Sacred mountains, particularly Hōraisan
monsters.physical_description: The Kirin is one of the most beautiful creatures in Zerox Enon, appearing as a chimerical being with the body of a deer, the tail of an ox, the hooves of a horse, and a single horn on its forehead. Its body is covered in scales rather than fur, each scale gleaming like a jewel. Flames dance around its feet, but these flames do not burn—they purify.
monsters.lore: The Kirin is an omen of great events—the birth of a wise ruler, the founding of a new dynasty, the beginning of a golden age. It appears only in times of peace and justice, and its presence blesses the land with prosperity. Unlike many mythical creatures, the Kirin is utterly benevolent.

passive.name: Purifying Presence
passive.description: The Kirin constantly emits an aura of purity. Corrupted beings near it take damage, while pure beings are healed.

basic_skills.name: Horn of Justice
basic_skills.description: The Kirin's horn glows, striking a target with purifying light.

basic_skills.name: Flame Step
basic_skills.description: The Kirin moves, leaving purifying flames in its wake.

special_skills.name: Blessing of Prosperity
special_skills.description: The Kirin blesses an area, causing crops to grow and resources to appear.

special_skills.name: Wisdom's Gift
special_skills.description: The Kirin shares its wisdom, granting insight to an ally.

special_skills.name: Peaceful Presence
special_skills.description: The Kirin calms all beings in an area, preventing violence.

unique_skill.name: Judgment of the Just
unique_skill.description: The Kirin judges a being. The just are blessed; the unjust are cursed.

ultimate_skill.name: Golden Age
ultimate_skill.description: The Kirin calls upon the power of perfect harmony, transforming an area into a paradise where all allies are blessed and all enemies are pacified.

monster_hierarchy.name: Divine
monster_hierarchy.description: Divine monsters are beings that have ascended to godhood or were born as gods. They wield power over aspects of existence and are worshiped by mortals. They are the rulers of the pantheons, the forces that shape reality itself.

monsters.name: Ryūjin
monsters.habitat: The Celestial Sea surrounding Tenryuku
monsters.physical_description: Ryūjin is the Dragon God of the Sea, one of the most powerful beings in Zerox Enon. He appears as an immense dragon, larger than continents, whose body is made of living water and coral. His scales are like islands, his eyes like suns reflected in the ocean, and his voice is the sound of all the seas at once.
monsters.lore: Ryūjin is the father of all sea dragons and the ruler of the undersea Dragon Palace. He is a benevolent god, generally, though his moods shift with the tides. He rewards those who respect the sea and punishes those who abuse it. His palace is said to be made of crystal and coral, tended by fish and sea creatures who serve as his court.

passive.name: Lord of the Sea
passive.description: Ryūjin has absolute control over water within his domain. He can create tsunamis, calm storms, or drown entire islands at will.

basic_skills.name: Tidal Wave
basic_skills.description: Creates a massive wave that can destroy fleets.

basic_skills.name: Coral Prison
basic_skills.description: Traps enemies in growing coral.

special_skills.name: Storm Call
special_skills.description: Summons a hurricane that devastates a wide area.

special_skills.name: Dragon Palace
special_skills.description: Summons his palace, which can serve as a fortress or transport.

special_skills.name: Tide Jewel
special_skills.description: Uses the tide jewels to manipulate water on a massive scale.

unique_skill.name: Judgment of the Deep
unique_skill.description: Ryūjin judges those who have wronged the sea. The guilty are dragged to the depths.

ultimate_skill.name: Ocean's Wrath
ultimate_skill.description: Ryūjin calls upon all the oceans of Zerox Enon to rise against his enemies, flooding continents and reshaping the world.

monsters.name: Tenjin
monsters.habitat: Shrines throughout Zerox Enon, particularly in Shinsekai
monsters.physical_description: Tenjin appears as a scholar of great age and wisdom, dressed in the robes of a Heian-era noble. His face is kind but serious, with eyes that have read countless books and seen countless students succeed and fail. In one hand, he carries a scroll; in the other, a brush that writes the fate of scholars.
monsters.lore: Tenjin was once a mortal scholar and poet named Sugawara no Michizane, who was unfairly exiled and died in disgrace. After his death, a series of disasters befell his enemies, and he was deified to appease his angry spirit. Now, Tenjin is the patron of scholarship, learning, and the academic arts.

passive.name: Fountain of Knowledge
passive.description: Tenjin's presence enhances learning and understanding. Allies near him gain experience faster and learn skills more quickly.

basic_skills.name: Brush Strike
basic_skills.description: A stroke of his brush that writes truth into reality.

basic_skills.name: Scroll Shield
basic_skills.description: Scrolls form a protective barrier.

special_skills.name: Wisdom's Gift
special_skills.description: Grants knowledge to an ally, temporarily boosting their abilities.

special_skills.name: Truth Revealed
special_skills.description: Strips away lies and deception, revealing truth.

special_skills.name: Student's Prayer
special_skills.description: Answers a prayer for help, providing assistance in times of need.

unique_skill.name: Exile's Judgment
unique_skill.description: Tenjin judges those who abuse knowledge. The guilty are cursed with ignorance.

ultimate_skill.name: Library of Heaven
ultimate_skill.description: Tenjin opens the celestial library, granting all allies access to infinite knowledge and power for a limited time.

monsters.name: Bishamonten
monsters.habitat: The celestial armies of Tenryuku
monsters.physical_description: Bishamonten appears as a fearsome warrior, clad in elaborate armor and carrying a spear and a pagoda. His face is stern but just, the face of a general who has led armies to victory and mourned every death. He is tall and powerful, his presence inspiring both fear and respect.
monsters.lore: Bishamonten is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune, the patron of warriors and the protector of holy places. He rewards the brave and punishes the cowardly, and his judgment in matters of honor is absolute. He leads the celestial armies against the forces of chaos and darkness.

passive.name: Warrior's Blessing
passive.description: Bishamonten's presence inspires warriors. Allies near him fight with greater skill and courage.

basic_skills.name: Spear of Justice
basic_skills.description: A thrust of his spear that cannot be blocked.

basic_skills.name: Pagoda Shield
basic_skills.description: His pagoda expands to form an impenetrable shield.

special_skills.name: General's Command
special_skills.description: Bishamonten issues orders that allies must obey, granting them bonuses.

special_skills.name: Warrior's Judgment
special_skills.description: He judges a warrior's honor. The honorable are blessed; the dishonorable are cursed.

special_skills.name: Honor Guard
special_skills.description: Summons the spirits of fallen warriors to fight for him.

unique_skill.name: Fearless
unique_skill.description: Bishamonten cannot be frightened or intimidated, and he grants this courage to allies.

ultimate_skill.name: Heaven's Army
ultimate_skill.description: Bishamonten calls upon the full might of the celestial armies, summoning countless warriors to fight for him.

monster_hierarchy.name: Ascended
monster_hierarchy.description: Ascended beings are those who have transcended even divinity, becoming one with the fundamental forces of existence. They rarely interact with lower beings directly, but their influence shapes all of reality.

monsters.name: Amaterasu
monsters.habitat: The sun itself, occasionally manifesting in Tenryuku
monsters.physical_description: Amaterasu is the goddess of the sun, and her true form is the sun itself—a being of such intense light and heat that no mortal can look upon her directly. When she chooses to manifest in a form comprehensible to lesser beings, she appears as a woman of breathtaking beauty, dressed in white and gold, surrounded by radiance so bright it obscures her features.
monsters.lore: Amaterasu is the ruler of the Celestial Court, the ancestor of the imperial line, and the source of all light and life in Zerox Enon. She is utterly benevolent, wishing only for peace and prosperity for all beings. According to legend, she once retreated into a cave after a quarrel with her brother, plunging the world into darkness.

passive.name: Source of Light
passive.description: Amaterasu is the sun. She radiates light and heat constantly, and darkness cannot exist near her. All beings in her presence are warmed and healed.

basic_skills.name: Sunbeam
basic_skills.description: A beam of pure sunlight that can heal or harm as she wills.

basic_skills.name: Radiance
basic_skills.description: Her light reveals all truth and strips away all illusion.

special_skills.name: Dawn
special_skills.description: Amaterasu brings the dawn, ending night and restoring energy to all beings.

special_skills.name: Sunrise
special_skills.description: Her rise brings light and life to the world.

special_skills.name: Mirror of Truth
special_skills.description: She shows beings their true selves, which can be enlightening or devastating.

unique_skill.name: Cave Retreat
unique_skill.description: Amaterasu can withdraw her light, plunging an area into darkness that only she can see through.

ultimate_skill.name: Solar Flare
ultimate_skill.description: Amaterasu releases a fraction of her true power, creating a flare that can destroy anything in its path or heal anything in need.

monsters.name: Tsukiyomi
monsters.habitat: The moon, occasionally manifesting in Shinkage
monsters.physical_description: Tsukiyomi is the god of the moon, and like his sister Amaterasu, his true form is the celestial body he rules. When he manifests, he appears as a figure of silver and shadow, beautiful and cold, with eyes that reflect the light of the sun without warmth. He is often depicted as a young man in flowing robes, carrying a crescent moon as a weapon or symbol.
monsters.lore: Tsukiyomi is Amaterasu's brother and the ruler of the night. Unlike his sister, he is distant and aloof, rarely involving himself in mortal affairs. He and Amaterasu were once close, but a terrible event drove them apart—Tsukiyomi killed the goddess of food, and Amaterasu refused to look upon him again.

passive.name: Night's Veil
passive.description: Tsukiyomi's presence brings night. Darkness conceals allies and confuses enemies, and the moon's light reveals hidden things.

basic_skills.name: Moonbeam
basic_skills.description: A beam of moonlight that can reveal truth or deal cold damage.

basic_skills.name: Crescent Blade
basic_skills.description: A blade shaped like a crescent moon that cuts through anything.

special_skills.name: Lunar Phase
special_skills.description: Tsukiyomi changes the moon's phase, altering reality based on the phase (new moon = concealment, full moon = revelation).

special_skills.name: Night's Blessing
special_skills.description: Blesses allies with the calm and power of night.

special_skills.name: Cold Embrace
special_skills.description: The cold of space itself, freezing enemies.

unique_skill.name: Separation
unique_skill.description: Tsukiyomi isolates a target, separating them from allies and reality itself.

ultimate_skill.name: Lunar Eclipse
ultimate_skill.description: Tsukiyomi eclipses the sun, plunging the world into temporary night and granting him absolute power over darkness.

monsters.name: Susanoo
monsters.habitat: The seas and storms, particularly around Kishima
monsters.physical_description: Susanoo is the god of storms and the sea, Amaterasu and Tsukiyomi's brother. He appears as a wild, untamed figure—muscular and rough, with wild hair and eyes that flash with lightning. He carries a massive sword and often appears drunk or enraged, depending on his mood.
monsters.lore: Susanoo is the most unpredictable of the three siblings. He was banished from heaven for his wild behavior, but in his exile, he performed great deeds—most notably, slaying the eight-headed serpent Yamata-no-Orochi and founding the imperial line through his descendants. He is both destroyer and creator.

passive.name: Storm's Heart
passive.description: Susanoo is the storm. Lightning strikes near him constantly, damaging enemies randomly, and winds push foes away.

basic_skills.name: Lightning Blade
basic_skills.description: His sword strikes with lightning, dealing massive damage.

basic_skills.name: Wind Gust
basic_skills.description: A gust of wind that knocks back enemies.

special_skills.name: Storm Call
special_skills.description: Summons a devastating storm.

special_skills.name: Sea Rage
special_skills.description: Churns the sea, creating whirlpools and waves.

special_skills.name: Dragon Slayer
special_skills.description: His sword deals bonus damage to serpents and dragons.

unique_skill.name: Chaos Unleashed
unique_skill.description: Susanoo releases his wild nature, becoming unpredictable and gaining random buffs each moment.

ultimate_skill.name: Heaven's Banishment
ultimate_skill.description: Susanoo banishes a target from heaven, stripping them of divine protection and casting them into chaos.
